note: Beyblade X parts catalog for the collection picker. Name roster cross-referenced against beybxdb.com's parts guide (Sep 2026) plus a few extra confirmed bits it didn't list (Kick, Vortex, Wedge). `system` (BX/UX/CX), `role` and `spin` are still best-effort — that site lists names/photos only, not stats — so a blank `role`/`spin` means genuinely unconfirmed rather than guessed. Community-maintained — send a PR to add a part or fix a detail. Role colours: Attack = red-orange, Stamina = teal, Defense = amber, Balance = violet.
imageNote: For photos: set imageBase to a folder URL and name each file after the part slug (run `npm run parts:slugs` for the full list) — e.g. imageBase "./assets/parts/" gives ./assets/parts/dran-sword.png. imageBase can also be an external CDN URL. Or put an explicit "image" URL on any single entry (that wins). A missing or broken image falls back to the generated icon.
